column1: # dispatch-effort-bindings.tsv -- DGN-1770: (runtime, axis, model) -> measured
# reasoning-effort default. DATA, not logic: dispatch-detached.sh
# resolve_effort() reads this file when --effort is omitted, exactly as
# bottleneck_gate() reads dispatch-tier-bindings.tsv when --model is omitted.
# Why a SIBLING file and not a 5th column on dispatch-tier-bindings.tsv: the
# tier table is keyed (runtime, axis) -> model LIST; effort is a property of
# ONE model on that axis (opus and sonnet share the accuracy row but measured
# differently). A per-model key does not fit a per-row column, and the tier
# rows' model columns are not to be touched by this ticket.
# Columns (TAB-separated): runtime  axis  model  effort  evidence
#   model  = the dispatch alias (fable|opus|sonnet|haiku), same vocabulary as
#            the tier table; codex slugs come from dispatch-model-display.tsv.
#   effort = low|medium|high  -> passed to the runtime, EFFORT_SOURCE=table
#            -                -> MEASURED, effort changed nothing: no flag,
#                                CLI default, EFFORT_SOURCE=no-effect
#   Routing rule (docs/AGENT-RATIONALE.md, Model routing): pick the LOWEST
#   effort with no measured loss. So a measured-flat cell is written as `low`,
#   not `-` -- `-` would hand the run to the CLI default, which is the
#   expensive end. `-` stays available for a flat cell where low itself is
#   unverified; no row uses it today (leader review 2026-09-28).
#   No row -> UNMEASURED: no flag, CLI default, EFFORT_SOURCE=unmeasured. A
#   guessed value never goes here; an unmeasured cell stays out of the file.
# Evidence source: effort bench (docs/bench on branch dsp/dgn1750,
# results/scored.json; claude n=5 on a1/a2/c3, n=2 elsewhere; codex n=3).
# Tasks: a1/a3 small-evidence verify, a2 large-evidence verify (1347 paths,
# 43 claims), c1/c2/c3 small-population coverage. NO tool use in any task, so
# these are reasoning-only measurements.
# Not measured anywhere, so deliberately absent:
#   judgment axis (every runtime) -- no re-derivable answer set exists
#     (DGN-1666); fable was excluded from the bench (cost).
#   cloud runtime -- same Claude models as claude-code, but the cloud launcher
#     has no verified effort control, so a default would be recorded and never
#     applied (DGN-1770 item 5: record-only).
